column2: Cart to Quote skips email approval delays — one click turns a cart into a formal quote request.
Maria navigates to her cart and reviews the items: office supplies, cables, adapters totaling $850 NZD.
She clicks Request Quote at the bottom. The system generates a unique quote ID and shows the quote summary.
Her manager David receives the quote notification instantly — he can approve or reject with a comment.
The quote status displays live: Pending Approval. Maria knows exactly where her request stands.
Budget quarter protected. Quote filed. Decision cycle: one session, not three days.
